title: Heavenly Fate Converges
next_chapter_hook: When Chen Ji's fingers touched the fourth page of the Tianji Record, time across the entire Three Realms seemed to freeze for an instant—and the light in Ling Yuan and Han Lie's eyes was fading in a most peculiar way.

text.content:
When the shackles of fate are severed, what is the true price of freedom? Ling Yuan and Han Lie gazed at Chen Ji, their eyes blazing with unprecedented light—and all of this was merely the beginning of a greater chess game.

At the convergence point of the Three Realms, a chasm-like rift tore open in the heavens, purple-black thunder roiling within like a boiling cauldron. The will of the Heavenly Eye pressed down on every soul like a mountain, making even breathing an unbearable burden.

dialogue.content:
"Countdown reaches zero." The Heavenly Eye's voice no longer carried its previous overwhelming pressure, but rather an almost mechanical coldness, "Chen Ji, what is your choice?"

Three illusory doorways slowly manifested before Chen Ji, beyond which lay endless chaos and void.

text.content: Chen Ji felt the Heavenly Fate Value within him draining frantically—that was proof of the bond between the Tianji Record Fragment and his destiny. He gazed at the three doorways, calculations racing through his mind. The Heavenly Fate Value had fallen below ten points; if he forced another foresight, the Three Realms would plunge into utter annihilation alongside him.

dialogue.content:
"Chen Ji!" Su Qingyao suddenly spoke, her voice carrying unprecedented urgency, "I see a fourth door!"

She grabbed Chen Ji's wrist abruptly, pointing toward the fourth silhouette faintly emerging in the void ahead, "The fourth page of the Tianji Record—that is the source power of the Fate Writer!"

text.content: Chen Ji followed Su Qingyao's fingertip, and indeed, between the gaps of the three great doorways, caught a faint golden glow. That was a realm the Tianji Record had never shown him—the fourth page, the Fate Writer.

dialogue.content:
Mo Xiansheng's voice echoed in Chen Ji's mind, carrying a rare gravity: "Master, the fourth choice may require a price—one who rewrites the laws of heaven will be struck back by heaven, becoming the new Heavenly Eye."

He paused, "But this is also the only path that can preserve everyone."

text.content:
Three breaths. Only three breaths remaining.

Chen Ji felt the Heavenly Eye's will piercing his soul like ten thousand fine needles, the final summons. The Three Realms began to shudder, countless cracks spreading through the void, the bell tolling for the end times.

dialogue.content:
"Choose, pawn of destiny." The Heavenly Eye's voice carried a hint of mockery, "Die freely, or replace me and become a new puppet? Or—perish together with all of this?"

That mockery was like a dull blade, scraping against Chen Ji's heart.

dialogue.content:
"If you leave," Su Qingyao's voice trembled, "who will guard this Three Realms? Who will guard—me?"

Her eyes reddened, but stubbornly refused to let the tears fall.

text.content: Chen Ji turned to look at Su Qingyao, his gaze questioning. The fourth path—how did she see it? The Tianji Record has never revealed this door to him.

dialogue.content: 'Because I saw it.' Su Qingyao's voice suddenly became ethereal, 'When you first used the Tianji Record, I already saw the existence of the fourth page—just that at that time, you weren't ready.'

text.content:
One breath. One breath remaining.

Chen Ji felt the Tianji Record violently trembling within his body, a reaction to being suppressed by the Eye of Heavenly Dao's will. He looked at Su Qingyao—this woman who had always tried to uncover his secrets, now her eyes held only trust and anticipation.

dialogue.content:
'No matter what you choose,' Su Qingyao said softly, 'I will stand by your side. This is my choice—and the meaning of my existence.'

Her voice was soft, yet it clearly reached Chen Ji's ears, instantly calming his chaotic thoughts like a stabilizing elixir.

text.content: Chen Ji took a deep breath. Heavenly Fate was draining frantically, and time did not allow him to hesitate any longer. The tremors in the Three Realms grew increasingly violent, and cracks in the void had begun devouring everything around them.

dialogue.content: "No!" Su Qingyao rushed forward, gripping Chen Ji's hands tightly with both of hers. "If the price is you being trapped here forever, then I'll stay with you! We'll rewrite this damn rule together!" Her eyes shimmered with tears, yet held a resolute light within them.

text.content: Chen Ji looked at Su Qingyao—at this woman who had tried to uncover his secrets from the very beginning, yet ultimately chose to fight by his side. He recalled the Tianji Record's prophecy—the Shared Fate buff, which would share the consumption of Chen Ji's Heavenly Fate Value.

"Qingyao," Chen Ji said softly, reaching out to brush away the tears at the corner of her eyes. "Aren't you afraid?" Su Qingyao shook her head, her voice trembling yet utterly firm: "I am. But compared to losing you, I fear this Three Realms without you even more." At this moment, for the first time, something unplanned appeared in Chen Ji's chess game that he had been calculating for countless years—genuine heart.
Chen Ji smiled. That smile was no longer the calculated arc of old, but a genuine sense of liberation and warmth. He clasped Su Qingyao's hand in return, feeling the warmth of her palm.

dialogue.content: "Hahahaha—" The Heavenly Eye suddenly burst into earth-shaking laughter. "Interesting! How fascinating! Chen Ji, you are the most interesting chess piece I've ever seen—since that's the case, I'll let you see clearly what this so-called Fourth Possibility truly is!" A majestic will crashed down, enveloping both Chen Ji and Su Qingyao within it.

text.content: Chen Ji felt unprecedented power surge through his body—the essence of the Fate's Scribe from the fourth page of the Tianji Record. He saw countless threads of destiny intertwining, saw the past, present, and future of the Three Realms.

However, at this very moment, Chen Ji saw the truth of the fourth page—it was not a new path, but the possibility of unifying all paths into one. Freedom, Replacement, Mutual End—these three paths would exist simultaneously, with him personally writing the new rules.

Chen Ji opened his eyes, golden light blazing in his gaze. He held Su Qingyao with one hand, while the other slowly rose to touch that faint fourth door. "Heavenly Eye," his voice calm yet firm, "your chess game ends here." The moment his fingers touched that door, time across the entire Three Realms seemed to freeze for an instant—and the light in Ling Yuan and Han Lie's eyes was fading in some uncanny manner.
